editedExercise.name: Pistol Squats

instructions.description: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart. Shift your weight onto your left leg and extend your right leg straight in front of you, keeping it lifted off the floor.
Engage your core and slowly bend your left knee while pushing your hips back and lowering toward the floor. Keep your extended right leg lifted and your chest as upright as comfortably possible.
Lower as far as you can while maintaining control and good alignment. Then press firmly through the entire left foot, especially the heel, to return to standing.
Lower the right leg, switch sides, and repeat the movement with your right leg supporting and your left leg extended.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions completed with controlled technique.

commentsNotes: Keep the supporting foot firmly planted, including the heel and forefoot.
Keep the supporting knee tracking in the same direction as your toes.
Engage your core to help maintain balance and a stable torso.
Move slowly and use only as much depth as you can control.
Hold onto a stable support if needed for balance or assistance.
Avoid letting the supporting knee collapse inward.
